# Forward-chaining check of the boardgame question: does the shark dance with the dugong?
# Propositional program: the rule set is finite, so this closure is exact (not sampling).

FB_FOUNDED = 2004          # Facebook founding year (fact used by Rule2)
MOVIE_YEAR = 2010          # chihuahua's movie release year

RAINBOW = {"red", "orange", "yellow", "green", "blue", "indigo", "violet"}

SUBMITTED = "unknown"

def neg(lit):
    return lit[1:] if lit.startswith("~") else "~" + lit

facts = set()

if MOVIE_YEAR > FB_FOUNDED:

facts.add("invests(shark,fangtooth)")
if SHARK_AGE_MONTHS < 18:

if SHARK_FRIENDS > 10:
    facts.add("many_friends(shark)")

# Rules: (name, antecedents, consequent); "~" marks negation
RULES = [
    ("R1", ["works_in_education(ostrich)"], "~invests(ostrich,shark)"),
    ("R2", ["hides_cards(chihuahua,shark)"], None),  # already applied as base fact
    ("R3", ["smiles(x,basenji)", "disarms(x,zebra)"], "~dance(x,dugong)"),  # per-animal, handled below
    ("R4", ["invests(shark,fangtooth)"], "pays(shark,badger)"),
    ("R5", ["hides_cards(chihuahua,shark)", "~invests(ostrich,shark)"], "disarms(shark,zebra)"),
    ("R6", ["rainbow_card(ostrich)"], "~invests(ostrich,shark)"),
    ("R7", ["young(shark)"], "photo(shark,swallow)"),
    ("R8", ["pays(shark,badger)"], "smiles(shark,basenji)"),
    ("R9", ["many_friends(shark)"], "photo(shark,swallow)"),
]

# Rule3 is stated for "one of the animals"; instantiate it for the shark only (the query subject)
RULES_SHARK = []
for name, ants, cons in RULES:
    if name == "R3":
        RULES_SHARK.append((name, ["smiles(shark,basenji)", "disarms(shark,zebra)"], "~dance(shark,dugong)"))
    elif cons is not None:

changed = True
while changed:
    changed = False
    for name, ants, cons in RULES_SHARK:

print("Derived facts:")
for f in sorted(facts):

# Consistency check: no literal and its negation both derived
conflicts = [f for f in facts if neg(f) in facts and not f.startswith("~")]
print("Conflicts:", conflicts if conflicts else "none")

# Decisive values
print("chihuahua movie year > Facebook founding:", MOVIE_YEAR > FB_FOUNDED)
print("ostrich card color rainbow:", OSTRICH_CARD_COLOR in RAINBOW)

print("shark smiles at basenji:", "smiles(shark,basenji)" in facts)

query_pos = "dance(shark,dugong)"
query_neg = "~dance(shark,dugong)"
if query_neg in facts and query_pos not in facts:

elif query_pos in facts and query_neg not in facts:
    verdict = "proved"
else:

print("CHECK PASS" if verdict == SUBMITTED else "CHECK FAIL")
